variables.document: Section 9.2: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon sixty (60) days prior written notice, subject to an early termination fee of 20%.
variables.claim: The agreement allows termination with 15 days notice and zero early termination fee.

variables.document: Backups run nightly at 01:00 UTC and snapshots are retained for 30 calendar days.
variables.claim: Snapshots are kept for roughly one month, including holiday weekends.
